description:
1920s America, Chicago.   
The golden days of the mafia during the Prohibition Era.   
And a Joseon man named Jason, who finds himself in their midst. 

Will he make it in the underworld, or will he fail?  With only his fists to rely on, Jason fights for survival in this action drama!
